quests.title: Empty a pile of any size
quests.ask: In a two-cell corridor with one pile, pick up every gem in the pile. Your code shouldn't care how many there are.
quests.nudge: How could the robot tell that the pile is empty?

quests.title: Piles anywhere along the way
quests.ask: Now a longer corridor with piles in different places. Check every cell the robot steps onto.
quests.nudge: Which line runs once for every cell? That's where to look for gems.
